tiles.title: Design system — Trust
tiles.hero:
Since the first ledger

Exact,
steady, clear.

Navy and white, tabular figures and nothing that feels like a gamble.

StatementsMattersAccounts
tiles.text:
## Principles

- Exact over exciting: figures line up, labels say precisely what a number is.
- Nothing surprising: every action says what happens before it happens.
- Quiet authority: navy and white, one warm accent, square-ish corners.

## Starter profile

- **Fits:** banking, accounting, law, insurance, wealth, government, enterprise. Not for children, entertainment.
- **Mood:** formal, calm; density medium; shape sharp; contrast high; light first.
- **Type:** IBM Plex Serif, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono.
- **Adapt first:** accent, link, ring. **Keep:** primary, foreground, font-label.

## Using tokens

Use a token by its name, never its value. Change a value here and every screen and every component sample below follows: colors, type, spacing, corners, shadows, opacity and motion. Each color shows its light and dark values and is checked against the color it is read on.

## Using components

Build screens from the components in this system. Each one is drawn below in its states, with a note on when to use it. When one is missing, add a row to Components.

## Accessibility

Text reaches 4.5:1 against what it sits on; control edges and focus 3:1. Focus is always visible. Nothing is told by color alone.
